name: Air Conditioner Production Line Solutions
summary: Full-line automation solutions for air conditioner indoor and outdoor unit manufacturers, achieving high-takt, high-quality mass production goals.
contentHtml:
The air conditioner production line solution is a full-line automation solution provided by TXAM for manufacturers of air conditioner indoor and outdoor units.

Solution Composition

The full line covers the entire process including heat exchanger assembly, pipeline connection, vacuum evacuation, refrigerant charging, helium leak detection, electrical wiring, performance testing, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Precision heat exchanger assembly ensures heat exchange efficiency
  • Automated pipeline system significantly reduces leakage rates
  • High-precision charging system ensures accurate refrigerant charge
  • Helium mass spectrometry leak detection offers high sensitivity for seal testing
  • Fast multi-model changeover with short changeover time
  • High level of full-line automation for high production capacity and efficiency

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
